title: Clinical Research Manager
description: TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full service-capabilities, resourcing and Functional Service (FSP) solutions. Join Our Team as a Clinical Research Manager (CRM) – home based in Argentina or Brazil. About This Role As part of our Ophthalmology team you will work alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals. The Clinical Research Manager (CRM) is responsible for coordinating and overseeing country and site management activities throughout study conduct, ensuring high‑quality delivery in accordance with company SOPs, regulatory requirements, and contractual obligations. Key Responsibilities Oversee day‑to‑day clinical operations to ensure delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH/GCP, and regulatory requirements. Serve as the primary operational contact for Sponsors, providing updates, managing expectations, and ensuring high‑quality study execution. Lead and support CRAs, including training, supervision, performance oversight, co‑monitoring, and review/approval of monitoring visit reports. Ensure site and country performance through proactive review of monitoring activities, protocol deviations, data listings, recruitment progress, and issue escalation. Maintain oversight of study documentation, including TMF quality, CTMS accuracy, monitoring plans, training plans, and study‑specific materials. Collaborate with the Project Manager on study planning, investigator payments, resource allocation, study communications, and revenue forecasting. Contribute to study meetings, Investigator Meetings, feasibility assessments, and, when required, local project management, CRA support, and bid defense activities. Qualifications Minimum 5 years of clinical monitoring experience in a CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environment. At least 1 year of experience as a Clinical Research Manager (CRM) with proven oversight of site and country operations. 1+ years of experience in Ophthalmology (OPH), ideally within retina indications such as DME, AMD, GA, RVO, or inherited retinal diseases (IRDs). Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required. Strong understanding of ICH/GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical operations processes. Demonstrated ability to lead CRAs, manage study deliverables, and collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams. What We Offer We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients. A Bit More About Us TFS HealthScience is a global, mid‑sized Contract Research Organization (CRO) partnering with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies across the full clinical development lifecycle. Our expertise spans full‑service clinical development, project‑based support, strategic resourcing, and Functional Service Provider (FSP) solutions, matching experienced professionals to roles where they deliver the greatest impact. Our Core Values Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability guide our decision‑making at all levels and foster a unified, collaborative culture. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Professor(a) de História IB (History) - Barra da Tijuca/RJ
description: O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 126 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo. Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de História IB (History) para o Ensino Médio. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina. RESPONSABILIDADES O que você fará: Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona; Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência; Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos; Ministrar aulas de História (History) alinhadas com o currículo IB, a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital); Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos; Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado; Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares; Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado; Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola; Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados; Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado; Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias; Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola; Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding). Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo. REQUISITOS O que você precisa ter: Diploma de Licenciatura em História; Experiência com Ensino Médio; Inglês fluente para ministrar as aulas nesse idioma. Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter: Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe; Paixão pela profissão; Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks; Estar sempre em busca de melhorias; Atitude positiva frente a mudanças; Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada; Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas; Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala; Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado; Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho; Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência prévia com o currículo IB; Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais; Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time; Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída. DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MÉDICO DO TRABALHO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Descrição da vaga Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar atendimento a exames admissionais, demissionais, periódicos, avaliação médica, retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função, encaminhamento ao INSS ou a médicos especialistas. Orientar restrições e recomendações conforme necessidade de cada caso. Realizar avaliações de atestados médicos, acidentes de trabalho e outras conforme a necessidade da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Medicina do Trabalho. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico do Trabalho. Informações adicionais Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - RJ; Escala de trabalho: 20 horas semanais; Horário: A combinar. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Strong experience in financial modeling, underwriting and investment analysis. Experience supporting or executing investment transactions, due diligence processes and transaction structuring activities. Solid understanding of corporate investments, financial statements analysis and risk assessment methodologies. Experience in carbon credit related fields would be highly advantageous. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. We value diversity and inclusion and highly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups. Strong alignment with Finance in Motion’s mission and impact‑driven investment approach. Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver high‑quality outputs under tight deadlines. What you can expect An agile, widely diverse international working environment with employees of 68 nationalities that is keenly interested in making a positive difference through their work and who share a collaborative, can‑do spirit. A company that is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive, contribute, and grow. A job that allows you to fully utilize and expand your skills within an innovative, hands‑on company culture. A purpose‑driven, performance‑oriented company that rewards above‑average results. An organization dedicated to providing effective training and upskilling to its employees. A company that offers a flexible and amicable work environment, placing a high value on work‑life balance. We, a team of over 300 dedicated professionals across 16 regional offices worldwide, are committed to advancing sustainable development through pioneering finance solutions. If you relish tackling complex challenges hands‑on and crave an adaptable and motivating work environment, we’re eager to connect with you. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somo proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros. title: Head of Customer Proposition
description: About the Role We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day. Not remote: This is a hybrid role in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for a commercially driven and customer-centric Head of Customer Proposition to join our Brazil team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the local 360° customer proposition strategy across our core product verticals, including Sports, Gaming and Social . As a senior leader within the Brazil Commercial organisation, you will oversee the ideation, development and execution of market-leading propositions that attract, engage, reward and retain customers throughout their lifecycle. You will lead a team of local product vertical experts and work cross-functionally to ensure our customer experiences are locally relevant, insight-led and commercially impactful. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Brazil, and wider regional and global stakeholders, you will shape and execute the local proposition strategy aligned to broader regional objectives, ensuring we deliver standout experiences that strengthen customer loyalty, increase engagement and drive sustainable growth in the Brazilian market. This role requires a deep understanding of the Brazilian betting and gaming landscape, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for delivering best-in-class customer experiences through innovation, personalisation and operational excellence. What You’ll Be Doing Define and lead the Brazil customer proposition strategy across Sports, Gaming and Social verticals, aligned to wider regional and global business objectives. Develop and execute a local proposition roadmap that enhances customer engagement, retention, cross-sell and lifetime value. Lead and develop a high-performing team of vertical managers/leads, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability and customer obsession. Partner with senior commercial and marketing stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities, market trends and competitive advantages within the Brazilian market. Customer Lifecycle, Retention & Engagement Collaborate with CRM to oversee the development and optimisation of lifecycle and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, retention, reactivation and higher-value segments. Ensure generosity and customer value are delivered effectively throughout key customer moments and major sporting and entertainment events. Drive advanced segmentation and personalisation strategies to create relevant, timely, and differentiated customer experiences. Collaborate with CRM and Performance teams to build sophisticated, data-led communication plans that improve engagement and long-term retention. Commercial Performance & Optimisation Own the proposition bonus and promotional investment strategy across all verticals, ensuring strong budget governance, efficiency and ROI. Monitor and optimise proposition performance against key commercial KPIs including retention, conversion, cross-sell, active days, engagement and customer value. Lead the Test & Learn roadmap for Brazil, identifying and prioritising experiments that improve customer and commercial outcomes. Use customer insights, analytics, and market intelligence to continuously evolve proposition performance and identify new growth opportunities. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Product, GTM, Commercial, BI, CRM, Performance Marketing, Operations and Brand teams to ensure seamless proposition delivery and execution. Ensure alignment between local commercial priorities and the central Sports, Gaming and Social product roadmaps. Support acquisition strategies by optimising propositions and promotional mechanics to improve marketing efficiency and conversion performance. Collaborate with Analytics and Performance teams to build best-in-class reporting frameworks and performance dashboards to inform strategic decision-making. Market & Regulatory Excellence Maintain a strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape and ensure all proposition activity complies with local requirements and responsible gaming standards. Stay informed on competitor activity, customer behaviours and emerging market trends to ensure propositions remain innovative and market-leading. Champion a customer-first approach across all proposition initiatives and touchpoints. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in a senior proposition or commercial leadership role, ideally within the iGaming, sports betting or digital e-commerce/fintech space. Strong knowledge of the Brazilian betting, gaming, and digital consumer landscape. Proven experience building and executing customer proposition and retention strategies across multiple verticals. Strong commercial and analytical acumen with experience managing promotional budgets and performance KPIs. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing and developing high-potential teams and individuals. This role involves direct role management responsibility. Deep understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, personalisation, cross-sell and engagement strategies. Experience leading Test & Learn initiatives and using data-driven insights to optimise customer and commercial performance. Ability to oversee complex cross-functional initiatives/projects to completion and deliver successful business outcomes Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Passion for innovation, customer experience, and delivering market-leading propositions. Preferred Experience Experience across Sportsbook, Casino/Gaming and Social or community-led products. Familiarity with onsite/crm tools, bonus engines, and customer analytics tools. Experience operating within a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment. Understanding of responsible gaming principles and local compliance requirements in Brazil. About Super We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide. Shaping the Future of Play Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page: super.xyz/careers Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA). At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance. title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Municipio do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e a integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem-estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. title: Sales Manager, Industrial Instruments- São Paulo
description: Location: Rio de Janeiro, BR Why Join Us? The Sales Manager, Industrial Instruments (South LAM) will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding market share across Brazil and South Cone countries for Vaisala’s Industrial Instruments portfolio. This role focuses on key industries such as data centers, life sciences, food & beverage, automotive, and other measurement‑intensive industrial sectors. You will lead new business development, grow existing accounts, develop OEM business, and strengthen our distributor network. This position is ideal for a self‑driven sales professional with strong technical acumen and experience in industrial environments who is comfortable working in an international organization. What’s Your Role? Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue and profitability targets, while expanding Vaisala’s presence and installed base across the territory. Proactively identify, target, and acquire new customers in key industries (data centers, life sciences, food & beverage, automotive, and other measurement‑intensive industries) within the South LAM region. Identify and develop OEM opportunities, building long‑term partnerships where Vaisala’s Industrial Instruments are integrated into customers’ equipment and solutions. Work closely with existing distributors to strengthen their sales and technical capabilities, and actively support the identification, recruitment, and onboarding of new partners, in collaboration with the Channel Partner Manager. Deliver impactful technical and commercial presentations, demos, and training to customers, partners, and associations, clearly articulating the value of Vaisala’s Industrial Instruments. Oversee the entire sales process from lead qualification to closing deals, ensuring a seamless customer experience. Utilize Salesforce to track sales activities and customer interactions. Work closely with internal stakeholders (local and international), including product management, marketing, customer service, and field service, to align sales efforts with company objectives and secure customer satisfaction. Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities in target industries, and provide structured feedback to support portfolio and strategy development. What Will You Bring? Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (electrical, electronic, automation, mechanical, or related field). 5–10 years of experience in technical sales within industrial markets, ideally selling instrumentation, sensors, automation, or related solutions to process or manufacturing industries. Proven track record of developing new business and consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets. Experience managing distributors or partners and building a structured partner network; OEM business development experience is a strong plus. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to both technical and management‑level stakeholders. High level of autonomy and self‑management, able to prioritize opportunities and manage a large territory. Availability to travel frequently across Brazil and South Cone countries, as required by the business. Fluent Portuguese and fluent English (written and spoken) are mandatory; Spanish language skills are a strong plus. Experience and discipline using CRM tools such as Salesforce. Residency in São Paulo – SP or surrounding areas, with availability for a hybrid work model (the office is in Vila Olimpia, São Paulo). What We Offer Competitive salary aligned with your experience and the market. Hybrid work model, combining office and home office. Flexible meal vouchers (Flash), compatible with regional standards. Full health and dental coverage (no coparticipation). Life insurance. An international, collaborative, and positive work environment, with opportunities to interact with global teams and develop your career in a high‑technology company. Ready to take every measure for the planet? Apply at the latest on June 25th, 2026 via the application form. description: RINA is currently recruiting for a Brazil Safety Plan Approval Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the Latin America Marine Division. Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts. Key Accountabilities Review and approve drawings of safety, fire protection, lifesaving equipment and environmental control on ships, offshore units, and marine equipment, in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and ship's conversions. Assist clients during the design and construction phase, providing guidance and support related to safety, fire protection, and lifesaving equipment. Education Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Engineering Qualifications Experience working with safety management systems, safety plan evaluation, or safety-related projects in the maritime industry. Solid understanding of maritime safety regulations (SOLAS, ISM Code, IMO, MARPOL) and their application in the approval of safety plans for ships. Ability to review, evaluate, and approve safety plans based on safety standards and regulations, ensuring proper implementation on ships. Knowledge of various safety systems on ships, including fire safety systems, life‑saving appliances, and emergency evacuation procedures. Experience conducting safety assessments and reviewing safety documentation, including risk assessments and safety plans. Understanding of the process of approving safety documentation for ships, including evaluating compliance with maritime safety regulations and recommending improvements. Proficiency in safety audits, inspections, and risk evaluations to ensure the continuous improvement of safety measures. Ability to work closely with senior engineers and other stakeholders, providing technical expertise and support to ensure the safety plan approval process runs smoothly. Strong communication and reporting skills to document findings and provide recommendations for safety improvements in compliance with regulations. Previous or current experience within an IACS member Classification Society, particularly in a Plan Approval Center, is considered a strong advantage. Main responsibilities Estratégia de Produto & Ciclo de Desenvolvimento (Sell In): Direcionamento de Mix: Definir o mix de produtos por canal e cluster, assegurando a total coerência entre o sortimento planejado, a pirâmide de preço e a meta comercial da marca. Gestão de Portfólio (Riscos e Oportunidades): Identificar gaps de categorias/subcategorias e faixas de preço; avaliar a concorrência e mapear produtos com alto potencial de escala ou riscos de baixa performance (bestsellers vs. slow movers). Tendências e Mercado: Monitorar continuamente o mercado exterior e referências internacionais para trazer inputs estratégicos para o desenvolvimento das coleções. Co‑criação e Ajustes: Participar ativamente do ciclo de desenvolvimento influenciando na inclusão e reforço de apostas, cancelamentos e retrabalhos de produtos. Performance de Produto & Execução Comercial (Sell Out): Monitoramento de Performance: Analisar o desempenho por SKU, categoria e cluster, acompanhando métricas cruciais de giro, sell-through, aderência de mix, presença de loja e eficiência de abastecimento (OTIF) entre os canais. Validação de Apostas: Validar se os produtos apostados performaram como o esperado no PDV, retroalimentando o time de estilo e planejamento com os aprendizados do ciclo. Diagnóstico de Execução: Identificar rupturas ou excessos de estoque em tempo real. Monitorar e mitigar os impactos de atrasos de fornecedores e cancelamentos nas vendas. Planos de Ação Táticos: Desenhar e coordenar ações rápidas como ajustes de exposição (VM), redistribuição de estoques entre canais (lojas físicas, franquias e digital) e ações comerciais direcionadas por produto. Requirements and skills Experiência Profissional: Sólida experiência em Planejamento Comercial, Merchandising de Produto (Product Merchandising), Planejamento de Demanda/Estoque ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente no segmento de varejo de moda ou bens de consumo. Competências Analíticas: Domínio analítico para leitura de indicadores de varejo (Sell‑In, Sell‑Out, Sell‑Through, Margem, Giro, Cobertura, OTIF, Markdown). Visão Sistêmica e Relacionamento: Capacidade de transitar e influenciar diferentes áreas (Estilo/Design, Logística/CD, Visual Merchandising, Operações de Lojas e Franqueados). Ferramentas: Domínio avançado de Excel e ferramentas de BI (Power BI/Tableau). Experiência com sistemas de gestão integrada (SAP, Linx ou similares) será considerada um diferencial. Formação Acadêmica: Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Moda com foco em Negócios ou áreas afins. (Pós‑graduação ou Especialização em Gestão de Negócios/Varejo é desejável). Principais Entregáveis do Cargo (Outputs) Direcionamento de Coleção e Proposta de Mix de Produtos por Canal. Desenho da Pirâmide de Preço e Plano de Sortimento por Cluster. Relatórios Periódicos de Performance de Produto (Análise de SKU/Categoria). Planos de Ação de Giro de Estoque e Alinhamento de VM. title: Digital Product Manager
description: Digital Product Manager Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first‑party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament‑time digital operations, delivering high‑traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross‑functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Provide clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross‑functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer‑first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI‑driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data‑driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline Relevant product development philosophies, e.g., Agile, are essential Relevant project management qualifications, e.g., PRINCE2, highly beneficial Work Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end‑to‑end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct‑to‑consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal—to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short‑term opportunities. Competencies: Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data‑driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross‑functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology: Strong knowledge of digital direct‑to‑consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. Experience with industry‑standard solutions, e.g., Figma, Asana and Confluence. Requirements: Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Principal Package Management Spec
description: Job Overview Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities, sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management. Responsibilities Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project. Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long-term outlooks. Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy-in. Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast. Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule. ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented. Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals. Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client. Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required. Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties. Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick-off meeting, PIM, and others. Oversee and enforce all day-to-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks. Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices. Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; this conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable. Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data. Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met. Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations. Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project. Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project. Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline). 8-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar). Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred. Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management. Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance. Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post-award activities such as execution, receiving, and commissioning. Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule. Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management. Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills. Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; at times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site. PMP and/or PE is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia. Traga a sua energia para a Light ! Responsabilidades e atribuições Seus desafios serão: Atender todas as novas demandas de Infraestrutura Física para as Áreas Técnicas de TI em todas as disciplinas (Elétrica, Climatização, Controles de Acesso, Detecção e Combate de Incêndio, Cabeamento Lógico estruturado, Monitoração e todas as demais) e em todos os municípios com presença da Light. Acompanhar as filas de chamados na ferramenta de Troubleticket (JIRA) para a equipe de Infraestutura Física de Áreas Técnicas de TI, garantindo o cumprimento dos SLAs definidos, solução definitiva e registros da Causa Raiz. Incentivar o acompanhamento das oportunidades de melhorias em todas as Áreas Técnicas de TI assim como na gestão do cumprimento das atividades. Relacionamento contínuo e de qualidade com todas as áreas clientes, sejam internos ou externos, entregando suas atividades dentro dos prazos e qualidade acordados. Monitorar todas as entregas previstas nos contratos que suportam as atividades da Área de Infraestrutura Física de TI, com o cumprimento nos SLAs definidos e autuação aos eventuais desvios encontrados com a aplicação das penalidades devidas. Garantir a continuidade da operação dos Ambientes de Missão Crítica de TI, com foco na mitigação de downtime destes ambientes. Atuar na análise de projetos com objetivo de garantir maior assertividade na entrega através de ativdades de Pré-Site, reduzindo prazos e otimização da infraestrutura. Fazer a gestão da capacidade de todos os itens referentes a Infraestrutura Física das Áreas Técnicas de TI de forma pro ativa, garantindo previamente os ajustes necessários e evitando falta de recursos de infraestrutura em qualquer disciplina. Garantir a atualização do inventário de todos os elementos de infraestrutura física dos ambientes de missão crítica e salas técnicas. Efetuar Ronda/Vistoria nas Áreas Técnicas de TI, avaliando toda e qualquer não conformidade na infraestrutura física, principalmente as que possam colocar em risco a operação da empresa. Produzir e manter os relatórios e apresentações da área com escopo técnico e gerencial. Requisitos e qualificações O que é necessário você ter: Ensino superior completo. Domínio no suporte aos elementos de infraestrutura elétrica em média e baixa tensão passando por elementos de sustentação da continuidade e geração da energia para os ambientes de Missão Crítica de TI. Domínio no suporte a infraestrutura de refrigeração com elementos específicos que garantam a continuidade das operações para as áreas técnicas TI que sustentam todas as aplicações de TI da empresa. Necessário conhecimento das demais disciplinas de infraestrutura física, como, Sistemas de Detecção precoce e convencional de incêndio, Sistemas de combate a incêndio, Sistemas de controle de acesso físico, cabeamento lógico estruturado, iluminação, asseio, Sistemas de CFTV, Sistemas de monitoração ambiental e infraestrura civil. title: ELECTRICAL ENGINEER
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, control, and project management to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking an engineer with 5+ years' experience in power-electronics design, testing, and manufacturing, as well as prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. The ideal candidate will be equally well versed in design, analysis, and test. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the development of power-electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems for our downhole drilling technologies. The role spans schematic design, prototype bring-up, validation testing, and field support — working closely with mechanical, firmware, and systems engineers, and providing direct technical support to operations and drilling crews during testing and deployments. Responsibilities Design & Development Develop power electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems and control applications. Create system block diagrams, schematics, wiring harnesses, and detailed electrical designs using engineering CAD software. Design and implement electrical stress tests (e.g., pressure, temperature, vibration) to ensure product reliability and durability. Look ahead at validation requirements, and develop and execute test plans and setups using both firmware and hardware debugging tools. Testing, Validation & Field Support Conduct prototype board bring-up, functional testing, and performance analysis. Troubleshoot electronic faults at the component and system level using diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and spectrum analyzers. Provide technical support to field service technicians and on-site drilling crews to resolve operational problems. Collaborate across mechanical, firmware, systems, and project teams on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture and ensure that all activities adhere to HSE policy. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 5+ years of power electronics engineering experience, ideally within advanced engineering for complex industrial product development environments. Experience with high-voltage transmission and protection, and motor control electronic circuits (motor drivers, position feedback) used in oil & gas drilling, electric actuators, automation systems, electric vehicles, and similar applications. Experience with DC-DC converters (Buck/Boost, Flyback) used in power supplies across industrial and consumer electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Experience with analog and digital filters used across transmission networks, radio, satellite, medical devices, and oil & gas sensors and signal monitoring. Experience with sensors found in industrial and commercial electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Proficiency with electronics simulation and CAD tools used to model, simulate, and design electronic devices. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong analytical thinking and ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working directly with operations teams, field service technicians, and on-site drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and resolution of operational problems. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Strong attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and configuration control. Demonstrated ability to work independently, execute project plans from high-level direction, and deliver reliably against schedule and milestones. Experience contributing to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working in the lab, on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping evolve them as systems mature. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early-stage and transitioning-to-commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSEE or MSEE preferred. Experience with embedded firmware development for high-voltage or motor control applications. Exposure to oil & gas, drilling, or downhole electronics qualification standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Training & Readiness Manager

The role ensures that all safety and security personnel — including direct hires and supplier staff — meet defined competence, licensing and readiness standards prior to deployment. The position establishes structured training frameworks, certification processes and exercise programmes to ensure operational preparedness across stadiums and non‑competition sites. The role supports the creation of a sustainable safety and security legacy in Brazil through structured upskilling and professionalisation of the workforce. Responsibilities Conduct a comprehensive market capability and capacity analysis to identify gaps and risks related to the provision of staffed safety and security services Identify applicable qualification, certification and licensing criteria within Brazil and its federal states relevant to guarding, stewarding, close protection and related disciplines Design and implement a bespoke description: Eletricista Manutenção I Job type: Full-time employee Valorizamos a Diversidade e Inclusão, buscamos pluralidade de perfis, gêneros, raças, orientações e identidades, porque acreditamos que contribuições e percepções de pessoas distintas nos ajudam a encontrar, juntos, soluções novas e sustentáveis em saúde. Responsabilidades Cumprir com as atividades de manutenção previstas nos planos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva das instalações, sistemas de distribuição elétrica e equipamentos acionados eletricamente. Receber e preencher as ordens de serviço de manutenção planejada e não planejada apontando ações executadas, materiais utilizados e tempos decorridos das atividades. Participar em estudos para nacionalização e substituição de componentes importados. Solicitar, quando necessário, contato com técnicos especialistas para troca de informações visando soluções de problemas de manutenção. Dar a assistência e suporte técnico necessário aos operadores da equipe de manutenção de forma a garantir a produtividade e a integridade dos equipamentos, dispositivos e sistemas elétricos. Atender prontamente aos clientes internos e externos sempre que solicitado nos assuntos inerentes às atividades realizadas. Elaborar lista de materiais necessários para a realização de intervenções de manutenção preventiva. Manter atualizados os registros de manutenção dos equipamentos e sistemas elétricos de modo a garantir a integridade dos históricos de manutenção. Participar na regulagem, ajustes, reparos, consertos, montagem, desmontagem de equipamentos e sistemas elétricos incluindo utilidades. Executar infraestrutura para a instalação elétrica de máquinas e equipamentos novos ou fazer o remanejamento dos mesmos quando da mudança de layout e reformas. Efetuar a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e corretiva em painéis de distribuição de força e controle de baixa tensão. Apoiar as manutenções planejadas e não planejadas das subestações elétricas de alta tensão classe 15 kV e dos grupos geradores de energia elétrica de baixa tensão. Apoiar a elaboração de projetos e executar a montagem de painéis de comando e proteção e de distribuição de baixa tensão. Entre outras atividades com patíveis com o cargo. Assistência odontológica. Vale alimentação. Farmácia/Dispensário com medicamentos gratuitos para você, pais, cônjuge e filhos. Previdência privada para que possa planejar seu futuro. Tem filhos? Você terá direito à creche (conforme unidade trabalho). Salão de beleza para que possa cuidar da sua saúde. Academia para cuidar da sua saúde. Programas de desenvolvimento, que oferecem parcerias em instituições de ensino com desconto. Licença maternidade. Licença paternidade estendida. title: Profissional Program Planning

Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade? Simplificar e automatizar templates de reporte sempre que possível. Criar e manter dashboards executivos que demonstrem a saúde do programa em todos os projetos ativos. Estabelecer uma rotina consistente de reportes, incluindo reuniões semanais, quinzenais ou mensais, conforme necessário. Preparar consolidações e resumos do programa para a liderança e executivos. Garantir que os dados dos projetos sejam precisos, atualizados e acionáveis. Manter visibilidade sobre o desempenho financeiro do programa, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, margem, burn rate e alocação de custos. Identificar lacunas relacionadas ao acompanhamento orçamentário, alocação de recursos, utilização de centros de custo, change orders e previsões financeiras. Sinalizar inconsistências para os gerentes de projeto e para a liderança do programa, permitindo ações corretivas. Apoiar os gerentes de projeto com recomendações quando houver desvios financeiros ou de entrega. Monitorar áreas compartilhadas entre projetos, incluindo recursos comuns, dependências cruzadas e custos não atribuídos. Gestão de Performance da Execução e Riscos Monitorar cronogramas, custos, mudanças de escopo, riscos, problemas, dependências e saúde das entregas em todo o programa. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de revisão com os gerentes de projeto. Questionar reportes incompletos, pouco claros ou quando o desempenho estiver abaixo do esperado. Identificar riscos antecipadamente e escalá-los com recomendações objetivas. Apoiar a elaboração de planos de ação corretiva para projetos atrasados, acima do orçamento, com falta de recursos ou sem responsáveis claramente definidos. Garantir que riscos, problemas e mudanças contratuais sejam identificados com antecedência suficiente para que a liderança possa atuar. Planejamento de Recursos e Capacidade Apoiar o planejamento de recursos e previsões de capacidade do programa. Monitorar se os recursos estão corretamente alocados aos projetos e centros de custo. Identificar situações de subalocação, sobrealocação e lacunas entre demanda e capacidade disponível. Apoiar a liderança na previsão de necessidades futuras de contratação com base no pipeline de projetos e compromissos de entrega. Ferramentas, Automação e Dados Utilizar ferramentas como Power BI, Pipedrive, Excel e outras plataformas de automação e reporte para aumentar a visibilidade e reduzir esforços manuais. Criar ou aprimorar dashboards que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real ou próxima do tempo real sobre o desempenho dos projetos e do programa. Promover melhorias contínuas nos processos de reporte, templates e qualidade dos dados. Trabalhar em parceria com gerentes de projeto, equipe financeira e liderança para tornar os dados do programa mais confiáveis e úteis para tomada de decisão. Para essa vaga, você deve ter: Experiência em suporte à gestão de projetos, gestão de programas, PMO, controle de projetos ou operações. Sólido entendimento de indicadores financeiros de projetos, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, burn rate, margem e change orders. Capacidade de consolidar informações de múltiplos projetos e identificar tendências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Forte experiência com Power BI, Excel e ferramentas de reporting/dashboard. Capacidade de trabalhar com gerentes de projeto e liderança para melhorar a qualidade dos reportes e a responsabilização dos envolvidos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e conforto para questionar informações incompletas ou inconsistentes. Capacidade de atuar em um ambiente em crescimento e dinâmico, onde processos ainda estão sendo estruturados e aprimorados. description: Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico. Sobre o Hospital Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Receber, conferir e armazenar os medicamentos e insumos; Controlar o estoque, distribuir, dispensar e fracionar medicamentos; Realizar a conferência da dispensação de medicamentos e insumos, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar o controle de temperatura do ambiente e geladeira; Confeccionar etiquetas para unitarização de doses de medicamentos; Separar medicamentos por paciente e/ou setores; Controlar os medicamentos devolvidos; Auxiliar na limpeza e organização do setor; Realizar todas as atividades pertinentes ao cargo, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar atividades de área/ setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor Imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino médio completo; Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo; Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia ou Auxiliar de Farmácia. title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description: About the Company: At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real‑world connections. Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Leads & Reactivation) As the Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Leads & Reactivation), you will develop and execute lifecycle programs that bring lapsed and churned users back into the experience and help convert new leads through owned channels including email, push, in‑app, and SMS. Reactivation will be the primary focus of this role, with an emphasis on understanding user behavior, identifying growth opportunities, and turning insights into high‑impact campaigns. You'll work hands‑on in Braze and in‑house tools while partnering closely with Product, Creative, Analytics, and Finance to shape programs that improve reactivation, lead conversion, and engagement. This role is ideal for someone who can move confidently between strategy and execution, bring structure to complex work, and use data to form a clear point of view. Own the strategy and roadmap for reactivating lapsed and churned users and converting new leads through lifecycle channels including email, push, in‑app, and SMS Analyze engagement, cohort, and customer behavior data to uncover drivers of reactivation, lead conversion, and churn recovery Build and manage the experimentation roadmap across messaging, incentives, audiences, channel mix, and timing Launch and scale lifecycle campaigns from ideation through rollout using Braze and in‑house tools Design, run, and analyze A/B tests that improve KPIs such as reactivation rate, lead‑to‑activation rate, and engagement Map consumer flows, identify friction points, and recommend scalable solutions or short‑term testing opportunities – define lifecycle KPIs, maintain reporting, and share clear insights, forecasts, variance explanations, and recommendations with stakeholders Partner with Creative, Product, Analytics, and FP&A to align lifecycle priorities and drive high‑impact growth initiatives Experience You Bring 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle or CRM marketing, consulting, analytics, or a data‑driven marketing role Hands‑on experience with user acquisition or growth marketing, including lead generation, conversion, and paid or owned acquisition channels Experience owning lifecycle programs from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights, testing plans, and business recommendations Experience designing testing strategies, running A/B tests, and using results to improve campaign performance Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and campaigns with minimal oversight Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of basic SQL for self‑serve data pulls Familiarity with Braze or a comparable email or lifecycle service provider, and experience using project management software such as Asana or JIRA The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We highly value diversity at our company and encourage people of all different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics. Note: This description outlines key responsibilities but isn’t intended to cover every task or duty. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed to support the team and business goals. #J-18808-Ljbffr
